**Beta.** The Marketplace only offers it if you enable beta versions for Awtrix Studio (⋮ → Redownload → Show beta versions).

### New
- **A better entity field.** The editor uses Home Assistant's own entity picker when the panel can load it. Otherwise, a search field finds entities by name or entity ID, with no limit on how many you have.
- **No more lost changes.** Leaving the editor with unsaved changes (Cancel or the back button) now asks first.
- **Dialogs inside the panel.** The browser's confirmation pop-ups are replaced by dialogs in the panel.
- **Save feedback.** A short message confirms that an app or indicator was saved or deleted.
- **A tidier editor.** The JSON and generated-result cards are collapsed until you open them.

### Fixed
- **The Layout field on AWTRIX NG (TC002).** It was sometimes missing when the editor was opened before the clock had told its screen size, and simple apps were then drawn at double size. The layouts are now offered while the size is unknown, the open form updates as soon as the clock tells it (what you typed is kept), and the last known size survives a reload of the clock.

Existing apps keep working as they are. There is nothing to change after updating.

**Please test the entity picker on your instance** and report anything odd in [#31](https://github.com/3615nulsi/ha-awtrix-studio/issues/31).
